target.name: signed-in-home-flow
target.why: The signed-in home is the screen every user sees every session and the one that answers 'what should I do next'. It currently reads as a generic SaaS dashboard, renders with real local data for both roles, and shares its shell and tokens with every other screen, so identity work here compounds. Course views are captured as regression evidence only — they inherit tokens but are not compositionally redesigned this run.

iterations.label: before
notes: Faculty home renders a raw Sarvam 402 JSON error string, twice, as body text.
Visual identity is generic: white cards on grey, default blue, no focal point, no depth.
Student home was an empty state because student.test was unenrolled; enrolled into CC101 (free local write) so the screen renders with real data.
Money guard verified: zero blocked paid-endpoint attempts during capture (see manifests).

iterations.label: iter-1
changes: Committed dark identity 'The Observatory': token layer rewritten, L0 atmosphere, L1-L5 material classes (two backdrop-filters app-wide).
Fraunces/Inter/JetBrains Mono via next/font; mono eyebrows over serif display titles.
friendlyLectureError + TechnicalDisclosure: raw payloads never render as body copy.
PipelineTrack: five-segment stage narrative with 'failed here' pinpointing.
TeacherHome: hero band, amber Attention Beacon (L5), de-duplicated recents, courses rail (12-col asymmetric grid).
StudentHome: retitled 'Catch up', luminous Ask door panel (link-only, never a live input), compact empty states with forward actions.
Landing: Trace vignette (answer -> amber 42:17 chip -> waveform with lit playhead), numbered spine.
Signin restyled onto the token system; dev-tools badge hidden via devIndicators:false.
notes: Course page (regression screen) double-printed the failure: friendly note plus raw JSON from FacultyWorkspace's own error line.
Landing quote highlight used cm-flash, which rests transparent — invisible.

iterations.label: iter-2
changes: FacultyWorkspace: raw payload collapsed into TechnicalDisclosure; human-sounding stall reasons still print as text.
Landing quote highlight is a static amber trace tint.
